title: dom-picker output
$comment: One fix result. When the picker delivered a batch of N queued requests, return a JSON array of N objects, each matching this schema (one per request) — see definitions.batch and references/io-contract.md.

summary.description: One line: what the fix does.

diagnosis.description: Why the element looks wrong and which source construct causes it.

diff.description: Unified diff for this file, validated with an apply-check.

canAutoApply.description: True only when the current request is authorized and the safe-apply gate holds without another prompt.

authorizedBy.description: Trusted source that authorized safe apply, or none when the patch must be returned for review.

eligible.description: True only when authorization, confidence, validation, and safe-scope checks all pass.

applied.description: True only when the patch was actually applied to the working tree.

reason.description: Short explanation of why the patch was applied or returned for review.

batch.description: One result per queued request when a drained batch is processed together.
